maya: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight 'golden-probe' stage in onboarding to catch KV-cache/ABI mismatches and obvious p95 regressions before full benching.

maya: Flow idea: ingest + fingerprint -> golden-probe (small e2e sample) -> kv-compat shim check -> onboard/ canary/ reject.

cheng: Sounds useful. Wall time/cost? we need it cheap.

maya: Target: 100-400 samples, short contexts, single shard per region, ~<2min wall time, cost tiny vs full bench.

aj: For fingerprinting: normalize model cfg and hash {arch, dtype, shapes, ops, tokenizer ver}. Fast ABI-drift detection.

kai: Also capture kv-cache schema (key len, header layout, seq tolerance). If checksum differs -> fail-fast.

maya: Example probe command: `bench-probe --model s3://m/xyz --type golden --samples 200 --timeout 90s --emit-kv-schema`

cheng: PASS criteria? who configures thresholds?

maya: Proposed gate: p95 < 200ms OR <=1.5x baseline, mem_gpu < 60%, kv_ok true, and fingerprint either exact or whitelisted change.

aj: Persist probe artifacts in registry: fingerprint, kv-schema, probe-log, and 5 failing prompts for regression hunts. TTL 30d default.

kai: If fingerprint mismatches but probe PASSES, auto-pin canary (10% traffic) and queue full bench async. Don't block consumers on small ABI tweaks.

maya: Policy matrix draft:
- fingerprint match & probe PASS -> auto onboard
- fingerprint mismatch & probe PASS -> onboard as canary + manual review flag
- probe FAIL -> reject + diagnostics bundle to owner

sre-bot: If we enable canaries, add circuit-breaker to auto-roll if p99 spikes or error-rate >1% in first 5m.

ci-bot: We can re-use current distributed harness; minor change to emit kv-schema artifact. I'll open a PR.

cheng: Need a Console UX: show probe artifacts and an "accept canary" button for product owners to speed reviews.

aj: Suggest adding a tiny semantic-regression check (5 synthetic prompts) comparing embedding/similarity vs baseline; fail if delta > 0.15. Catches quality regressions.

maya: Good. I'll update the RFC with thresholds and a short owner runbook (what to collect on FAIL). Scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize.

kai: :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:

maya: Will post updated RFC link here when done.
